name: Tier metric selector
description: Scores each provider, model and effort on the tier's own weighted public evaluations (public_metric.py), then lets passing work per dollar on shared cases at the prices on file, prepaid credits counted as cost, override with enough shared cases per arm (the threshold is data).
advantages: Free, offline and deterministic, with the weights, their reasons, the public numbers and their dates in data files.
disadvantages: Only as good as the public numbers (one aggregator supplies every scored number) and the owner's weights; a leaderboard revision moves the ranking until the rows are refreshed.
